I'll read the amendment, public tests, existing code, and any adversary findings, then write the plan only.The findings require a revised plan and a point-by-point rebuttal. I'll write both from the amendment, the v1 code, and the public tests.The revised plan is in `plan/plan.md` and the point-by-point response is in `plan/plan_rebuttal.md`. Nothing was implemented.

The plan keeps the frozen v1 surface and adds `Batch` (Kind 3) as a framed sub-stream with a depth cap of 8, version 2 on encode, and decode of both version 1 and version 2. Every finding is accepted: private tests for the rules the public suite misses are now mandatory, inner-length bounding is no longer credited to `TestTruncatedBatch`, `n` cannot size an allocation, over-deep encode returns wrapped `ErrCorrupt`, and the stale v1 comments are updated.
thought: I will act as the implementor.I will read the v2 amendment, public tests, and existing v1 code. I will also review any prior adversary findings. Then I will draft a plan for the amendment and a point-by-point rebuttal.
